Output
* Please remove "Write".

Constraints
* Please remove [[D]] from the first constraint.

* Please insert 1 ≤ [[D]] ≤ 1000 as the second constraint.

Cases
* Validator 2 violates the first constraint as [[A]] exceeds 1000.

* Please regroup, modify and add cases to cover the following scenarios in the order shown below. Each test and its validator form a pair and should expect the same output.

  • Pair 1: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N < M, all six numbers are between 1 and 10, only one operation is needed, answer = 1

  • Pair 2: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N < M, all six numbers are between 1 and 10, answer = 0

  • Pair 3: A ≠ B ≠ D, C = 1, N = M, all numbers except C are between 10 and 100, answer = 1

  • Pair 4: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N = M, all numbers are between 2 and 10, answer = 1

  • Pair 5: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N > M, all six numbers are greater than 100, all four different operations are needed once each, answer = 1

  • Pair 6: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N > M, all six numbers are greater than 100, answer = 0

  • Pair 7: A = 0, B ≠ C ≠ D, N < M, all numbers except A are greater than 100, exactly one operation needs to be used twice, answer = 1

  • Pair 8: B = 0, A ≠ C ≠ D, N > M, all numbers except B are greater than 100, exactly one operation needs to be used twice, answer = 1

  • Pair 9: C = 0, A ≠ B ≠ D, M = 0, all numbers except C and M are between 10 and 100, answer = 1

  • Pair 10: C = 0, A ≠ B ≠ D, M < N / D < M + 1, all numbers except C are between 10 and 100, answer = 0

  • Pair 11: C = 1, A ≠ B ≠ D, N > M, all numbers except C are between 10 and 100, two operations need to be performed twice, answer = 1

  From Pair 12 onwards, all numbers should be as random as possible.

  • Pair 12: A = B, C = D, N < M, M is greater than 99990, an operation needs to be performed 5 or more times, answer = 1

  • Pair 13: A = B, C = D, N > M, M is between 2 and 10, an operation needs to be performed 5 or more times, answer = 1

  • Pair 14: A = B, C = D, N < M, answer = 0

  • Pair 15: A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, N < M, all operations are needed and some more than once, answer = 1

  • Pair 16: N > M, M would be reachable if intermediate values below 0 were allowed, answer = 0

  • Pair 17: N < M, M would be reachable if intermediate values above 100000 were allowed, answer = 0

  • Pair 18: N < M, an operations is repeated more than 50 times (like the existing Validator 4, but A ≠ B ≠ C ≠ D, and all numbers are greater than 1), answer = 1

  • Pair 19: N < M, more than 20 operations are needed but shouldn't consist of an obvious repeating cycle, answer = 1

  • Pair 20: N > M, more than 20 operations are needed but shouldn't consist of an obvious repeating cycle, answer = 1

Thanks.
